verdict.rationale: Stripe documents restricted API keys with per-resource Read/Write/None permissions. It explicitly recommends them for AI agents ("Use RAK permissions to limit what an agent can do"). MCP access also supports OAuth with per-session revocation, separate live/sandbox governance, and connected-account scoping via RAKs. The live probe confirms the OAuth-gated MCP endpoint. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scoped keys restrict agent actions as documented.
